if (WIN32)
    if(MINGW)
        if( CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8 )
            set(OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mingw/x64 PARENT_SCOPE)
        else()
            set(OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mingw/x86 PARENT_SCOPE)
        endif()

         set(OPENSSL_USE_STATIC_LIBS TRUE PARENT_SCOPE)
    else()
        if( CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8 )
            set(OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/msvc/x64 PARENT_SCOPE)
        else()
            set(OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/msvc/x86 PARENT_SCOPE)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
